A story where loyalty has a price, secrets have a purpose, and every truth hides another mystery.

Enter the world of Kounteya — a gripping Crime | Mystery | Thriller that takes you deeper into a web of suspense, intrigue, and unexpected turns.

BK Chandrahasa

With a distinctive vision and a strong cinematic voice, director BK Chandrahasa brings Kounteya to life as a story driven by mystery, intensity, and layered characters—creating a world where every detail holds a meaning.

Starring:
Achutha Kumar
Manoranjan Ravichandran

Achutha Kumar appears as a determined cop, delivers a power-packed performance as he unravels the layers of the central mystery, while Manoranjan Ravichandran leaves a chilling impact with his intense and menacing portrayal as the antagonist, adding a gripping edge to the narrative.
